description: This file defines the EraseChip class, which provides a GUI component for erasing a microcontroller chip (specifically an STM32) via a command executed through a firmware flasher tool. It includes button setup, user confirmation dialog, and command assembly for the erase process.

classes.name: EraseChip
classes.description: A GUI component for triggering an erase command on a microcontroller chip, with user confirmation and command execution logic.

methods.name: EraseChip
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the erase button with an action listener to confirm user intent and execute the erase command.

methods.name: getEraseCommand
methods.description: Builds the command string to erase the chip using OpenOCD with the specified flash size.

methods.name: getButton
methods.description: Returns the JButton component associated with the erase action.
